messages.メインターゲットに振動を溜めるほど火力が伸びる、高加重値の怠惰打撃広域E.G.O: A multi-target Sloth Blunt E.G.O with high Attack Weight whose damage grows the more Tremor is built on the main target.
messages.広域の高加重値: 攻撃加重値が6と高い。解析Ⅲでメインターゲットの振動(威力+回: **High multi-target Attack Weight**: A high 6 Attack Weight. At Threadspin Ⅲ, +1 if the main target's Tremor (Potency + Count) is 30 or more; at Ⅳ, +3 at 100 or more.
messages.振動の付与: 1コイン目が振動回数を増やし、2コイン目が振動を付与する。メインタ: **Inflicting Tremor**: The first Coin increases Tremor Count, and the second Coin inflicts Tremor. Concentrating it on the main target is efficient.
messages.振動によるダメージ強化: メインターゲットの振動に応じて、コインごとのダメージ量: **Tremor-based damage**: Each Coin deals more damage based on the main target's Tremor. The third Coin gains +1% per Tremor, up to 50%, and the fourth gains +1% per point of (Potency + Count), up to 100%; at 100% or more, it triggers Tremor Burst twice.
messages.怠惰共鳴の偶奇: 奇数ターンは怠惰共鳴数が奇数、偶数ターンは偶数だと、攻撃後に精: **Odd and even Sloth Resonance**: If Sloth Resonance is odd on odd turns or even on even turns, he recovers 10 SP after the attack. For 3 turns after the attack, he loses 10 SP at each Turn End.
messages.パッシブ「メトロノーム」: 奇数ターンはダメージ量増加、偶数ターンは保護を得る。: **Passive — Metronome**: Grants Damage Up on odd turns and Protection on even turns. Accumulated Past builds with each turn after use, raising Clash Power and Offense Level.
messages.無条件でも威力が高いので、序盤に雑魚をまとめて削る使い方ができる。: Its power is high even without conditions, so it can be used early to chip down groups of weak enemies.
messages.振動を溜めてからフィニッシャーとして撃つ使い方もできる。長期戦ほど伸びる。: It can also be used as a finisher after building Tremor. It grows stronger in longer fights.
messages.怠惰共鳴の偶奇を合わせて、精神力の消耗を相殺する。: Match the parity of Sloth Resonance to offset the SP cost.
messages.必要資源は憤怒2・色欲2・怠惰6・嫉妬1で怠惰が重い。: It requires 2 Wrath, 2 Lust, 6 Sloth, and 1 Envy; the Sloth cost is heavy.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が4になり、振動による加重値+1が付く。: **Ⅲ**: Base Power becomes 4, and +1 Attack Weight from Tremor is added.
messages.Ⅳ: コイン威力が+4になり、50%以上での振動爆発の追加、最大共鳴数に応じた振: **Ⅳ**: Coin Power becomes +4, and an extra Tremor Burst at 50% or more, Tremor infliction based on the highest Resonance, and HP recovery are added. The Coin Power gain is large, so take it if you can afford it.
messages.東部親指カポIIII: 怠惰(S1・守備)の資源を出せ、S1〜S3が振動を付与す: **[The Thumb East Capo IIII](persona:0512)**: Supplies Sloth resources (S1, Defense skill), and S1–S3 inflict Tremor.
messages.バラのスパナ工房フィクサー: S1〜S3が振動を付与し、怠惰(S3・ガード)で資: **[Rosespanner Workshop Fixer](persona:0505)**: S1–S3 inflict Tremor, and Sloth (S3, Guard) supplies resources.
